item.title: Disgrace
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Prima
  • 発売日: 2001-10-12
  • スコア: 6.2299999999999995/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ディスグレイス
  • 英語名: Disgrace

あらすじ

The protagonist lives with his father and older brother. He was living in a dorm, but due to a renovation he’s forced to return home. Because his father and brother work, he ends up spending all of his time alone in the house. The lady next door and her daughter take care of him since he is unable to cook for himself.

item.title: Ai-Sai
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Prima
  • 発売日: 2000-11-24
  • スコア: 6.470000000000001/10 (13 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 愛妻 ai-sai
  • 英語名: Ai-Sai

别名

  • Aisai

あらすじ

Main character is from a wealthy family. His classmate’s family in in debts with protagonists’ father, so classmate’s mother agrees to clean the mansion to decrease the debt amount. Protagonist lusts for the woman, and she unexpectedly surrenders to his will. The everyday fun begins, and then it’s classmate’s and her sister’s turn.
